title: Lear flew drug flights for CIA operations
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of Lear flew drug flights for CIA operations, about 1980s at dirt runways, unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He also knew a lot about CIA operations in the um when they were flying drugs

plain: A filmmaker, Jeremy Corbell, says that a pilot named John Lear knew a great deal about operations run by the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, in the 1980s. According to Corbell, these were flights carrying drugs off dirt runways, and Lear flew them. If true, it would place Lear inside secret government work, lending weight to his other claims.
